title: Bangsamoro group urges Marcos, MILF to complete peace process

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several organizations from the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) urged President Marcos and Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) chair Al Haj Murad Ebrahim to complete the peace process before the 50th Tripoli Agreement anniversary. In an issued manifesto, the 10-signatory organization called on Marcos to complete decommissioning and sign the exit agreement within his term. “The peace process began under President Ferdinand Marcos Sr. with the Tripoli Agreement in 1976. On Dec. 23, 2026, it turns 50. History has handed his son the chance to finish it,” the group said in a statement. READ: BFP claims […]...
